message: Lead examined new 7021c003 in-flight reservation design. Two pre-review concerns: (1) requiresDurableActivityReservation now wraps common SearchText/SearchFiles/ReadFiles and every self TaskWrite call in TWO canonical Git transactions (begin+end) even for brief operations; prior 100 GetAssignment benchmark doesn't measure that hot path. Benchmark 100 representative read_files/search_text/self-notification calls, with Git subprocesses/latency/lock effects; seek a coherent cheaper fence for short calls without surrendering cross-device correction safety. (2) reservations have no TTL and remain forever if client/process dies between begin and end, precisely when administrative stale-Working correction is needed. Design an explicit safe, audited owner/operator recovery route with proof operation is no longer active (not a blind expiry), and test crash/reconnect, ambiguous completion/replay, and stuck reservations. Also consider long-running read-only operations omitted from reservation list when heartbeat fails. Keep review frozen boundaries and no deploy.
